description: The AutoHide dock appears when focus-dock enters keyboard navigation and remains visible through the end of the capture.

assertions.comment: The panel hidden by AutoHide appears smoothly from 0 to 1 when entering keyboard navigation.
Keyboard navigation becomes active after entering focus-dock even in AutoHide mode.
The exact QTimer delay frame is not fixed; verify only that the panel remains fully visible at the end of the ample capture.
The first item keyboard focus also remains through the end instead of disappearing with AutoHide.
